name: Social Experiences, Resilience, and Identity Lab
description: SERI Lab studies social experiences, resilience, and identity: intergroup relations, discrimination, coping, and well-being. Directed by Dr. Maor Shani at Ariel University.
title: Social Experiences, Resilience, and Identity
tagline: Research on intergroup relations, discrimination, and well-being.
introduction: We study how identities and social experiences shape people’s attitudes, relationships, and well-being. Our research examines intergroup conflict and discrimination, belonging and inclusion, and coping with social and health-related challenges.
